[LTIM.6.6] **A component of a `Date` is that component of its midnight in
UTC.** A `Date` ([LTIM.1.2.1]) is held as the number of days since 1970-01-01
in the proleptic Gregorian calendar, negative before it. The compiler **must**
lower `.day`, `.month`, `.year` and `.day_of_week` on a `Date` to the
[LTIM.6.5] builtin of the same component, applied to the instant `d · 86 400 ·
10⁹` nanoseconds and the zone `UTC`. Every `Date` has that instant, because its
range is the days whose midnight is a `Time` ([LTIM.1.2.2]), so the read always
has an answer. A `Date` has no `.hour`, `.minute` or
`.second` ([LTIM.6.1]).
